replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body:
Adding on to what I said earlier, all the other platforms such as skype and teamspeak are used by the "regulars". People who are new to a server won't know if there is a teamspeak and such by visiting the website one time. The chatbox can be used as an introduction to the server and will encourage more people to participate in the website's activities whether it be browsing the forums or checking your statistics. 

I think that if they don't have a website account, they could be labeled as a guest, but once they make an account, they can have their IGN displayed. I know for a fact people want to be recognized and not be called Guest26383829. With an implement of this chatbox, a new staff position could also be created called Web Mod. Perhaps for the more avid forums users. They could also have permission to lock/archive topics and such.

Basically there is nothing bad with adding a chatbox and this could be another thing to bring in more players. Adding the "apply for staff" message has already brought in a few players and I think this could be a good investment for the developers to do.
